direction.reason: Index in established downtrend (Price < EMA20 < SMA50); long setups restricted

springyDip.rule: OWN springy dip: lag-1 autocorrelation (120 bars) < -0.05 AND close at least 2 standard deviations under its 20-day average; buy at the open, sell at the close 5 sessions later

backtest.verdict: FAIL (too weak to rule out luck)

LU.rule: Long-unwinding bounce: the share fell at least 1.56% and its futures open interest fell at least 3.04% -> buy at the next open, sell at the close 10 sessions later
LU.backtest: FAILED as a short (−1.97% / −0.85% / −1.04% a trade); the bounce is that loss read the other way, untested

SB.rule: Short build-up: the share fell at least 1.56% and its futures open interest rose at least 3.04% -> short at the next open, cover at that day's close
SB.backtest: FAILED (+0.296% / +0.020% / +0.131% a trade; final t 1.86, not enough after 12 tests)

STRANGLE.rule: Sell the NIFTY call about 2% above and the put about 2% below, at the close of the first session with 4-10 days to the weekly expiry; hold to expiry
STRANGLE.backtest: PASS under protocol v2: +0.101% of NIFTY a week, t 4.66, 61 months (not significant after the 73-trial Deflated Sharpe check)

MA150A.rule: Short a stock whose close crosses below its 150-day average; cover 10 sessions later; scored against the market
MA150A.backtest: PROMISING: +0.338% a trade above the market, t 2.26

MA150B.rule: Short a stock whose 5-day average crosses below its 150-day average; cover 10 sessions later; scored against the market
MA150B.backtest: PROMISING: +0.307% a trade above the market, t 2.58
